limitations: M1/M2 are textual parsers of Lean source; declarations produced by macros or tactics generating new constants would only be seen by M3.
M3 covered only branches that compile on the frozen P01 base; non-compiling branches cannot be kernel-scanned.
Repositories other than m-core-p-vs-np were scanned at branch tips only, not full history.
Repositories for other conjectures (Riemann, Beal, BSD, Hodge, Yang–Mills, Navier–Stokes, Poincaré) were not scanned in this cycle.
Markdown/JSON/LaTeX claims were not treated as proofs; only kernel-checkable terms count.
